hypotheses.title: Favoritos control does not update the UI state correctly
hypotheses.observedEvidence: After clicking the top-level Favoritos control, the UI does not reflect any changes in the state of favorites, and the text 'Sua coleção de desejos Favoritos 0 achados' remains unchanged.
hypotheses.expectedBehavior: Clicking the Favoritos control should update the UI to reflect the current state of favorites, such as the number of items saved or any changes in the displayed content.
hypotheses.risk: Users may be confused about the state of their favorites and may not be aware of any changes or updates to their saved items.
hypotheses.oracle: After clicking the Favoritos control, the UI should reflect the current state of favorites, such as the number of items saved or any changes in the displayed content.

hypotheses.title: The 'Abrir meus favoritos' button does not lead to the expected favorites interface
hypotheses.observedEvidence: The 'Abrir meus favoritos' button is present in the UI, but there is no visible indication of what the interface will look like when clicked, and no other buttons or links are explicitly associated with the favorites interface.
hypotheses.expectedBehavior: The 'Abrir meus favoritos' button should lead to a dedicated favorites interface that displays all saved items, with clear navigation and visual cues.
hypotheses.risk: Users may not be able to access their saved items or may be unsure of how to navigate to the favorites section.
hypotheses.oracle: Clicking the 'Abrir meus favoritos' button should lead to a dedicated favorites interface that displays all saved items, with clear navigation and visual cues.

hypotheses.title: The 'Favoritos' heading is not semantically or visually distinct from other sections
hypotheses.observedEvidence: The 'Favoritos' heading is present in the UI, but it is not visually or semantically distinct from other sections such as 'Comidas' or 'Pedidos', and there is no clear visual hierarchy or styling that differentiates it.
hypotheses.expectedBehavior: The 'Favoritos' heading should be visually and semantically distinct from other sections to ensure users can easily identify and navigate to the favorites section.
hypotheses.risk: Users may have difficulty locating the favorites section, leading to confusion and a poor user experience.
hypotheses.oracle: The 'Favoritos' heading should be visually and semantically distinct from other sections to ensure users can easily identify and navigate to the favorites section.
